title: Insert, delete and reverse in a builder

blocks.text: A `StringBuilder` changes in place: `insert(position, text)` puts text before the character at `position` (or at the end, when `position` is the length), `delete(start, end)` removes the characters from `start` up to but not including `end`, and `reverse()` turns the sequence around.
Write three methods in `Edits`, each building on a `StringBuilder` of its input:

cases.says: An insert, a delete to the end, and a reverse.
deleteRange("abcdef", 1, 3) is "adef": the character at end stays.
insertAt("Hello", "!", 5) is "Hello!": the length is a valid position.

concepts: insert, delete and reverse change a builder in place, and delete(start, end) stops before end.
